MINIMAL, BRIGHT, CLEAN — Vienna only

Five screens end to end: find something, browse it, read a place, book a class, see it on a map.

Off-white paper, ink text, three bright colours carrying meaning: marigold = eating out, rose = courses, jade = shops and open-now. No shadows on content, hairline dividers, lots of air.

PICTURES

Every listing has an image from day one — a flat top-down drawing in the brand's four colours, sitting in the temple-arch frame. Real photos replace them one at a time as they arrive. The set and the reasoning are on the sheet below.

BRAND

Logo 4 developed — horizontal and stacked lockups, one-colour version, app icon down to 44 px, palette and type. Bottom right.
The first-round explorations, kept for reference. B was utility-first, C was community/events-first, and the sheet below held the six logo candidates — option 4 won.
